title: perfect size
text: perfect size. Bought this set for my Mom when I purchased her first toaster oven.  She is thrilled both with the oven and the wonderful size of these pans.  They wash up nicely because they are non-stick coated, inside and out.  A good buy if you have and really use your toaster oven!  They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in excellent condition.

product_metadata.title: Farberware Bakeware Steel Nonstick Toaster Oven Pan Set, 4-Piece Baking Set, Gray
features: PFOA-FREE NONSTICK: Long-lasting nonstick on these baking trays promotes excellent food release and easy cleanup when making pizzas, cookies or even small casseroles. No Rolled Edges
DURABLE TOASTER OVEN BAKE PANS: The toaster oven baking tray set’s heavy-duty construction resists warping and heats evenly to brown beautifully and help reduce hot spots.
GREAT FOR DORMS AND APARTMENTS: This cookie pan, pizza tray and cake set and every other piece of Farberware Bakeware uphold a long tradition of reliability, value & performance.
HIGH HEAT TOASTER OVEN READY: The toaster oven pans in this 4-piece pizza, cake, and cookie tray set are oven safe in toaster or conventional ovens to 450 degrees Fahrenheit.

PRODUCT DETAILS: Farberware 57775 Bakeware Nonstick Toaster Oven Pan Set, Includes Two 10-Inch x 7-Inch Cookie Trays - 10" L x 7" W (interior)/ 10.8" x 7.5" (exterior), one 10-Inch x 7-Inch Cake Pan - 10" L x 7" W (interior)/ 10.8" x 7.5" (exterior), one 7-Inch Pizza Pan - 7" L x 7" x W (interior)/ 7.5" x 7.5" (exterior). Steel Construction.
description: Farberware Bakeware meets the demands of all the busiest kitchens, and this 4-Piece Farberware 57775 Bakeware Nonstick Toaster Oven Pan Set is designed for creating toaster oven favorites. Just the right sizes for the Farberware Toaster Oven, the bake pans in this set make it easy to enjoy homemade pizzas, cookies and even smaller casseroles. The toaster oven baking tray set includes two 10-inch x 7-inch cookie trays perfect for baking chocolate chip cookie or biscotti, a 10-inch x 7-inch cake pan for creating strawberry cake or brownies, and a 7-inch pizza pan for making french bread pizzas. Product dimensions are as follows: Cake and Cookie Pans are 10" L x 7" W (interior), 10.8" x 7.5" (exterior). Pizza Pan is 7" L x 7" x W (interior), 7.5" x 7.5" (exterior). Featuring heavy-duty steel construction, the durable toaster oven pans reliably resist warping and heat evenly to help reduce hot spots that can burn baked goods. Nonstick inside and out delivers great food release with quick cleanup. Each toaster oven pizza tray, cake pan, and cookie pan is oven safe to 450°F. Even better, this entire mini tray set makes an ideal addition to the standard-size bakeware and other pans in the Farberware Bakeware collection.
